candidates.statement: Checkout 502s originate downstream: order returns 502 to gateway, and order's payment call fails with 503 Service Unavailable from payment:8000/v1/authorizations, propagating as 502 at /v1/checkout. Inventory/redis calls succeed (200).
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side cause (config, saturation, crash) not observed; logs excluded. Gateway latency is low, so not a gateway-local fault.

report.explanation: Traces show consistent failure chain: gateway /v1/checkout 502 <- order 502 <- payment 503 on /v1/authorizations, while inventory/redis succeed. Metrics confirm ~80% of checkout requests 502 with low p95 latency (~94ms), ruling out gateway latency. Root cause is bounded to the payment dependency failing, but the specific payment fault is unobserved, so handoff-level detail is missing.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs/metrics for /v1/authorizations 503s to determine root cause (config, saturation, crash)
Order service logs to confirm 502 is purely propagated from payment
Payment deployment/version facts to rule out bad-configuration or rollout cause
